notes.title: 蜥学东渐主线更新公告
notes.notes: Update 0.4.14: Main storyline updated to Chapter 3.

notes.title: GECKORIENTALISM Main Story Update Announcement
notes.notes:
After an intense and thrilling period of preparation, GECKORIENTALISM is finally advancing its main storyline! The new chapters will focus on the impact of the Lizardmen invasion on the inland regions—rising new elites versus a crumbling old society, an influx of refugees clashing with the indifference of locals, cautious scheming against radical vengeance, and of course, the contrast between white-haired girls and nice body ladies…

The new storyline will be available separately in the "Early Access to New Storyline" feature. Once this chapter's main story update is complete, it will be fully integrated into the game experience. Feel free to jump in and explore at any time!

Additional Content in Update 0.4.13:
Fixed entry and exit effects for character illustrations
Improved the overall story viewing experience
Optimized UI
Get ready for an exciting new chapter!

notes.title: 0.4.9 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
0.4.9 Update Announcement
Just a week after the last update, the new episode's voiceover has been added, so it's really diligent~ After this update, our game will enter a relatively stable version, and new players and old players who have bought the game but haven't played it yet are welcome to experience it.

0.5.0 Update Preview
Starting from 0.5.0, we will be serialising updates to the main storyline, advancing the story to a new climax! Many players' concerns about the elf society and the lizardmen's conspiracy will be revealed, as well as the appearance of new characters! The first update is expected within this year, so stay tuned~!

notes.title: 0.4.8 更新公告
notes.notes:
0.4.8 更新公告
1.千呼万唤始出来，《蜥学东渐》的新剧情终于和各位玩家见面了！正所谓万事开头难，作为一个世界观较为独特的故事，如何给玩家带来顺滑的代入体验一直是我们非常重视的问题。我们吸取了上版本的经验教训，另起炉灶制作了全新的导入剧情，希望能让各位玩家满意。至于上版本的导入剧情，将会回炉重造后出现在流程稍微靠后一点的位置。 新剧情的配音将会在下版本上线 。
2.重做了新手引导，现在的新手引导更加直观。
3. 修复了存读档界面中，最后保存时间显示不完整的问题，并优化了外观。
4.现在可以在游戏中找到感谢名单了。

更新预告：
- 0.4.9：将会补上新版引入剧情的配音
- 0.5.0 ：开始上线主线剧情第一章，以及对应的新版故事线机制、角色记忆机制等

2.优化重做了部分演出效果
3.优化修改了部分剧情效果

—最近制作组都在爆肝设定集，所以更新会比较少+比较慢—
